BiblicalUsage: The word names deeds, the acts men do whether good or bad, and the prophets weigh them in God's balance. God warns Israel that their doings will not allow them to turn to Him, and He repays every man according to his doings. Jeremiah says God tries the heart and gives to every man according to his ways and according to the fruit of his doings, and Hosea says Ephraim's doings are before God's face.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe our doings are never hidden from God, because He reads the heart behind every act. I hold that the same God who repays deeds also forgives them, and the one who turns to Him finds his doings covered by grace.
